stats-reset.s: THIS CLEARS ALL 28 AWARDS, EVERY LIFETIME
TOTAL, YOUR RECENT RUNS AND YOUR TOP TEN.
THE SAME AS A FRESH INSTALL.

help.s: CHAIN THEM TO KEEP A COMBO ALIVE.
A FULL METER JUMPS FOUR TIMES HIGHER
ONLY WITH THE METER AT MAX.
TAP JUMP AGAIN IN THE AIR. TWICE IN A 250 COMBO.
HIT A SIDE WALL WHILE AIRBORNE.
LAND TWO OR MORE FLOORS UP AND
KEEP DOING IT. STAND STILL AND IT ENDS.
AIR JUMPS, BOUNCES AND HELD CHAINS
RISES FROM BELOW AND SPEEDS UP.
FALLING IS SURVIVABLE. THIS IS NOT.
FLOOR 100, THEN EVERY 200, IT ALL CHANGES.

tutorial-0.s: GET AS HIGH AS YOU CAN BEFORE THE FLOOR TAKES YOU.
EVERY PLATFORM IS REACHABLE FROM THE ONE BELOW IT.
THE TOWER IS RANDOM, BUT IT IS NEVER UNFAIR.

tutorial-1.s: THE LONGER YOU RUN, THE FASTER YOU GO -- AND THE
HIGHER YOU JUMP. THIS IS THE WHOLE GAME.
A STANDING JUMP CLEARS TWO FLOORS.
LIVE -- THAT IS THE BOT BEHIND THIS PANEL

tutorial-2.s: HITTING A WALL ON THE GROUND COSTS YOU 30% OF YOUR
SPEED. BOUNCING OFF A WALL IN MID-AIR COSTS 6%
AND GIVES YOU A LIFT -- AND DEEP IN A COMBO IT
GAINS YOU SPEED AND THROWS YOU UPWARD.
SO DO NOT TURN. GO AT THE WALL.

tutorial-3.s: JUMP AGAIN IN MID-AIR. IT IS NOT FREE -- YOU ONLY
HAVE IT WHILE YOUR SPEED METER IS FULL.
SPEND IT ON THE WAY UP, NOT AT THE TOP.
LIVE -- THAT IS THE BOT BEHIND THIS PANEL

tutorial-4.s: CLEAR TWO OR MORE FLOORS IN ONE HOP TO START A
COMBO. KEEP DOING IT TO KEEP IT ALIVE -- STAND
STILL OR HOP A SINGLE FLOOR AND IT IS OVER.
EVERY 50 FLOORS OF COMBO RAISES THE MULTIPLIER
ON THE LEFT, AND THE TOWER SHOUTS ABOUT IT.
LIVE -- THAT IS THE BOT BEHIND THIS PANEL

tutorial-5.s: IT RISES THE WHOLE TIME, AND FASTER IF YOU STAND
STILL. WHEN THE SCREEN FLASHES RED, CLIMB.
THE HIGHER YOU GET, THE LESS ROOM IT LEAVES YOU
YOU CAN REPLAY THIS FROM GRAPHICS (O)

quit-blocked.s: THE BROWSER ONLY LETS A PAGE CLOSE A WINDOW IT OPENED.
LAUNCH WITH PLAY.BAT AND ESCAPE WILL QUIT PROPERLY.
CLOSE THE TAB, OR PRESS ANY KEY TO CARRY ON
